pages.text: Storms don't depend on vanilla rain. Each kind runs on its own timer, builds up for a minute or so, then fades. Every part of the world has its own timer, so one desert can have a sandstorm while another is clear.
Deserts and badlands get sandstorms: dust along the ground, a sandy fog and a haze over the screen. Snowy land gets blizzards. Misty places get fog, worst at dawn. Blossom woods get petal storms.
Flower fields have pollen on sunny days. Burnt land has ash falling. The snowy biomes show an aurora on clear nights. Bigger storms are loud. Indoors you barely notice any of it.
Every effect can be turned off in the Weather settings, and they turn themselves off if another weather or fog mod is installed. /alterraweather <storm> shows one right away.
